product_metadata.title: Sultan's Linens Eco-Friendly Peva Table Pad Waterproof Surface with Flannel Backing Floral (120-inch)
features: Wipes Clean With a Damp Cloth
description: Sultan's Linens table pad features a floral embossed 100% PEVA surface. PEVA is eco friendly and not harmful to the environment. The PEVA surface is waterproof and will stop any leaks or spills ensuring the best protection of your delicate table or furniture. The pad also features a soft polyester flannel backing to prevent any scratching to your table or furniture. The flannel backing also prevents skidding and keeps your tablecloth secure and in place. The Sultan's Linens Table Pad has many other uses; it can be used as a shelf liner or anything else you may need. It comes in many sizes, but may be trimmed or cut to any size necessary.It measures 120 inches long by 52 inches wide, please use the size guide to pick a suitable size for your table.
